lines: Oh, hey! Didn't see you float in.
I'm Satvik, a full-stack engineer based in Berlin, Germany.
For 6+ years I've been building products end to end, from React interfaces to APIs and AI features. Today I'm a Full Stack Engineer at Talon.One, an Adyen company.
Scroll, or hold S, and fly with me through my mission log. Helmet on!
intro.again: Welcome back aboard! The mission log continues just below.

about.label: Log 01 · Crew profile
about.title: Who I Am
about.subtitle: An engineer who builds AI-native products end to end, and cares about the people using them.
about.bio1: I'm a full-stack engineer with 6+ years of experience, currently a Full Stack Engineer at Talon.One, an Adyen company, in Berlin. Before that I spent 4+ years at Staffbase as a frontend developer, shipping AI-native features to 2,000+ enterprise customers, and worked on an ERP and a restaurant guest app at Codefitters. On the side I built Wealthbook, a personal finance tracker, solo.

values.title: AI-Native Builder
values.desc: I build high-quality products at speed using AI agents — writing precise prompts, reviewing and owning every line of generated code, and knowing exactly when to guide the model versus take the wheel myself.

values.title: Product-Minded Engineer
values.desc: I think beyond the component - obsessing over user flows, feedback loops, and the small details that make complex products feel simple. Good code ships features; great product thinking ships experiences.

values.title: Data Visualization Expert
values.desc: I turn complex datasets into intuitive, interactive dashboards using D3.js and Visx. Making data legible and beautiful is as important to me as making it accurate.

values.title: Performance First
values.desc: I obsess over Core Web Vitals, bundle sizes, and paint timelines — especially critical in data-heavy and analytics applications where rendering bottlenecks kill user trust.

values.title: Quality Engineer Mindset
values.desc: I write strongly-typed, well-tested code with a product instinct grounded in metrics. I read logs, interpret A/B results, and use data to drive UI decisions — not just intuition.

projects.label: Log 04 · Deployed payloads
projects.title: Selected Work
projects.subtitle: A handful of projects I'm proud of — from design systems to real-time apps.

descriptions.wealthbook: A personal finance tracker for people with money in more than one country. Wealthbook turns scattered accounts into one clear picture: net worth in your home currency, the real impact of exchange rates on your returns, AI insights in plain language, and goal planning per country. Designed and built solo.
descriptions.solarSense: It is a full-stack application built using the React, Node.js, Express.js, Supabase. It allows users to monitor and analyze photovoltaic data, visualize system performance, and generate reports.
descriptions.satvio: Snap a photo of your meal and instantly get a full nutrition breakdown — calories, protein, carbs, fat, and fibre. Meals are saved to your account so you can track what you eat over time.
descriptions.portfolio: A sci-fi themed portfolio website that keeps you up to date with my work experience, personal projects, and everything else I'm building.
descriptions.dataManagement: It is a comprehensive data management platform with a range of features such as user authentication, user profiles, file statistics visualization, file operations (CRUD), file tagging, file access control, file search, and file sharing with email notifications.
descriptions.portfolio3d: A 3D personal portfolio website showcasing my projects and skills using Three.js and WebGL.
descriptions.comingSoon: I'm always working on new projects and updating my portfolio. Stay tuned for more exciting work coming soon!

experience.label: Log 02 · Career trajectory
experience.title: Work History
experience.subtitle: Where I've worked and what I've shipped.

talonOne: Joined Talon.One, an Adyen company, as a Full Stack Engineer in Berlin in November 2026.
codefitters: Built CI/CD pipelines on GitHub Actions for two Angular/Firebase products (an ERP and a restaurant guest app): path-filtered pipelines with ESLint, Vitest/Karma, Firestore rules tests, i18n checks and gitleaks, enforced via required Quality Gate and Build Gate checks; automated releases with release-please, Conventional Commits and SemVer.

Replaced manual deployments with pipeline delivery to Firebase Hosting across 10+ targets using GitHub Environments with approval gates, smoke tests and tag-based rollback; added label-triggered PR preview environments on Firebase preview channels with automatic cleanup.

Led the monorepo migration (ADR, four-phase plan): extracted shared domain logic into a pnpm workspace package with lint-enforced import boundaries, migrated npm to pnpm workspaces, added CODEOWNERS and Dependabot, and scaffolded two zoneless, strict-TypeScript Angular apps.
Internationalized the ERP from German-only to DE/EN/HU across 28 modules, growing the ngx-translate catalog from ~270 to ~25,000 keys per language with CI parity checks.

Delivered a gamification engine for the guest app (XP, streaks, levels, challenges, CO2 metrics) and its UI redesign; hardened the ERP's AI assistant with owner-scoped Firestore rules, TTL expiry, server-side model enforcement for Vertex AI and AI-content labelling.
staffbase: Architected and shipped AI-powered features for an AI-native communication platform serving 2,000+ enterprise customers and millions of employees, including AI content insights and agentic workflow integrations.

Led discovery across 10+ projects with customers, PMs, and designers, architecting a behavioral tracking solution and a WCAG-compliant interactive visualization dashboard that surfaces real-time insights for millions of users.

Re-engineered the analytics platform using React, TypeScript, and Visx with RESTful APIs, delivered dynamic visualizations at scale, and shipped a cross-team component library adopted across multiple product teams.
Drove end-to-end migration of 3+ projects from discovery to production, authoring ADRs to align stakeholders, and modernized legacy UIs with client-side routing for a seamless SPA experience.

Migrated a fragmented micro-frontend architecture to a Turborepo monorepo, cutting build times by 2 hours and improving deployment efficiency by 200% through unified tooling and streamlined CI pipelines.
brillio: Architected the frontend of an enterprise stock order management SPA in React.js for an Australian retail client, used by thousands of users across hundreds of physical store operations.
Owned frontend tech stack decisions, evaluating and finalizing React.js, TypeScript, Redux, Styled Components, and Material UI as the core architecture for a scalable, maintainable foundation.
Delivered mobile-first, WCAG-compliant UIs with pixel-perfect precision, ensuring a consistent user experience across browsers and devices.
Mentored 2 junior developers via pair programming and code reviews, accelerating onboarding and improving team productivity.
wipro: Reduced manual operational effort by engineering client-facing web applications using React.js and JavaScript, delivering responsive, pixel-perfect UI solutions across multiple enterprise projects.
Implemented front-end features and integrated RESTful APIs with scalable state management, streamlining data flow across critical user journeys for hundreds of end users.
Utilized Git for CI and version control, and participated in agile cycles with Jira for efficient task management and high-quality releases.
Promoted design patterns, modular architecture, and reusable components and libraries to enhance scalability and maintainability.
